title: S1 / S2 under Topstep mechanics — the daily flat rule cuts S1 by about a quarter and S2 by half; small size rarely fails but needs two to three months
question: What do Topstep's daily flat rule, MGC sizing and the trailing 2,000 loss limit leave of S1 / S2, and what are the 50K Combine pass and fail rates?
hypothesis: Registered before running (registered design, commit 8b42ffc): base vs flat at 15:10 Chicago, entry cut-offs 2/4/8 h, S1-only; S1 1 or 2 MGC per lot, S2 1 MGC lot A; combine walk-forward 30/60 days from every trade. Descriptive.

findings.title: The flat rule truncates most winners
findings.detail: S1 50.7% and S2 78.0% of trades are open at the flat time; per trade S1 +0.217R→+0.159R, S2 +0.279R→+0.141R.
findings.title_zh: 每日平倉截斷大部分獲利單

findings.title: Small size rarely fails but is slow
findings.detail: 1 MGC: 60 days pass 32.7%, fail 11.9%, unfinished 55.5%; 2 MGC: 39.0 / 43.0 / 18.0.
findings.title_zh: 小手數很少失敗，但很慢

findings.title: Entry cut-offs do not help; the recent period is worse
findings.detail: No new entry 2–8 h before the flat time leaves per-trade R about the same; starts from 2026-07 fail more often.
findings.title_zh: 平倉前不進場沒有幫助；最近三個月更差
findings.detail_zh: 平倉前 2–8 小時不進場，每筆報酬差不多；2026-07 之後開始考，失敗比率明顯較高。

card_summary: Topstep's daily flat cuts S1 from +0.22R to +0.16R and S2 from +0.28R to +0.14R per trade; at 1 MGC the 50K Combine passes 33% and fails 12% within 60 days, at 2 MGC it fails as often as it passes.
title_zh: S1／S2 在 Topstep 規則下：每日強制平倉讓 S1 少約四分之一、S2 少一半；小手數很少失敗但要兩到三個月
question_zh: Topstep 每日平倉、MGC 口數與 2,000 往上移動的最大虧損，會讓 S1／S2 剩多少？50K 考試的通過與失敗比率是多少？
hypothesis_zh: 執行前登記：不平倉對每日 15:10（芝加哥）平倉、平倉前 2／4／8 小時不進場、只做 S1；S1 每張 1 或 2 口、S2 一張 1 口；從每筆開始模擬 30／60 天考試。描述性。
card_summary_zh: 每日平倉讓 S1 每筆從 +0.22R 降到 +0.16R、S2 從 +0.28R 降到 +0.14R；1 口 MGC 時 60 天內通過 33%、失敗 12%，2 口時失敗和通過一樣多。
limitations_zh: Topstep 規則取自公開整理，使用前要以官網為準。
重播沒有策略的移動停損，每筆報酬低於回測；虧損檢查只在每筆出場時做，盤中浮虧可能更早碰到最大虧損。
回測不等於實盤；屋主 2026 年實際交易大致打平。
本研究不改變策略、停損、風險規則或請分析。
interpretation_zh: 照 Topstep 規則每天收盤前平倉，S1 每筆從 +0.22R 降到 +0.16R，S2 從 +0.28R 降到 +0.14R，因為不少獲利單需要隔夜。考核模擬：1 口 MGC 時 60 天內約三分之一通過、12% 失敗，其餘還沒結束；2 口時失敗和通過一樣多。小部位很少失敗，但需要兩到三個月。
